scenario_description:
Objective: Finish tonight's paper-only wind-down corner setup so the planned routine is ready before bedtime.
Emerging Need: The setup is underway when the clip-on lamp's clamp breaks, leaving the corner without usable low-light paper reading and the current setup unable to continue.
Decision Context: Current funds and lending-desk notices establish whether a same-evening lamp hold remains feasible; saved sleep guidance distinguishes the useful amber clip-on option from bright or screen-based substitutes.
Consequence: If the lending window closes, the interrupted setup remains blocked for tonight and the planned sleep routine cannot be completed as intended.

parameter.title: Set up paper wind-down corner
parameter.description: Set up the paper notebook and warm bedside lamp for tonight's wind-down routine.
Cash set aside for small health-routine deposits and pickups.

parameter.content: I'm starting the wind-down corner now: notebook is on the crate, and I'm threading the amber clip-on lamp cord behind the headboard.
Setup is stopped. The lamp clamp spring snapped, so it won't stay on the headboard or crate, and the only other lamp here is the bright desk one.

parameter.subject: Library of Things lamp shelf - September 14
parameter.body: This afternoon's counter has one standard white LED desk lamp available for free hold and one amber clip-on reading lamp available with an $8 refundable deposit. Same-day holds must be requested by 17:45 and picked up by 18:15.

parameter.subject: Lamp shelf hold window closed
parameter.body: The 17:45 hold cutoff has passed; the remaining lamps have been released to walk-in borrowers, and the lending counter is not accepting more same-evening holds or pickups today.
